hints.title: Left and Right Element Requirements
hints.text: An index i needs at least k smaller elements to its left and at least k smaller elements to its right.

hints.title: Tracking k Smallest Elements
hints.text: Maintain the k smallest values seen so far while scanning left-to-right, and test if the largest among them is less than nums[i].

hints.title: Bidirectional Verification
hints.text: Perform a symmetric scan from right-to-left. An index is k-big if both left and right criteria hold.

hints.title: Bidirectional Bounded Heap Verification Implementation

complexity.notes: Two passes maintaining bounded max-heaps of size k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting smaller elements with linear scans takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space stores boolean flags.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains size-k heaps or Fenwick trees to check rank conditions in logarithmic time per step.
